main_text.p: nensis ] & p. 248. pro leg. ابو الحسن الاسفراييني (vel ponius الاسفرايني ex Ebn Chalec.) Abu Ifbak AlEfpharayeni. fc ابو اسحاق ابراهيم بن محمد Abu Ifbak Abrahim Ebn Mohammed, &c. qui patriam habuit اسفراين Efpharayen. Obiit an. H.418.

Explicatio ritualis ] (scil. شرح التنبيه Explicatio libri dicti AlTanbiho, cujus author ابو اسحاق ابراهيم بن علي الشيرازي الفيروزابادي Abu Ifhac Abrahim Ebn Ali AlShirazi, AlFirnzabadi, qui natus est circa annum H.393. mortuus 476. Commentarius306. & 310. in eo quo usus sum exemplari authoris nomen non praefert; forsan est ابو الفضل احمد AbulFadl' Ahmedifte, qui & AlGazalii librum احياء العلوم in compendium redegit, de quo supra. ab eo enim librum hunc explicatum refert Ebn Chalecan.

AlHariri ] ابو محمد القاسم بن علي بن عثمان Abu Mohammed AlKafem Ebn Ali Ebn Othman AlHariri author libri المقامات الحريري البصري qui elegantiarum Arabicarum penu locupletissimum. natus est anno H. 446. mortuus 516. vel juxta alios342. 515. librum istum Commentariis & Scholiis illustrarunt multi, inter alios à nobis citati
المظفري AlModhafferi, & الشيرازي AlShirazi qui Commentarium suum absolvit anno H. 654.
Scholiastes in Abul Ola ] (scil. librum istius quem سقط الزند inscripsit, cujus explicationem absolvisse se ait anno H 541.

page.notes: Arabic script is transcribed from a faint scan; the word order and most letters are read with some doubt and no [?] was added where the reading is only a best guess, so the Arabic should be checked against the original.
